description: A shell script for testing Git fetch functionalities, including fetching multiple remotes, fetch all, tags, and various fetch options. It sets up repositories, performs fetch operations, and verifies the output.

methods.name: setup_repository
methods.description: Initializes a new Git repository with a file, commits, and checks out a branch.

methods.name: setup_test_clone
methods.description: Clones a repository and sets up remote aliases.

methods.name: create_fetch_all_expect
methods.description: Generates expected output for fetch all branches tests.

methods.name: create_fetch_one_expect
methods.description: Generates expected output for fetching a single remote.

methods.name: create_fetch_two_as_origin_expect
methods.description: Generates expected output for fetching the 'origin' remote only.
